items.title: 9.8.3 How to Foster Innovation and Creativity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8.3 (PDF 222-223), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Har shakhs mein innovative aur creative banne ki salahiyat hoti hai. In skills ko barhane ke kuch tareeqe yeh hain:

items: Tajassus rakhein (Be Curious): hamesha sawal poochein aur dekhein ke cheezein kaise kaam karti hain. Curiosity (jaanne ka shauq) innovation ka pehla qadam hai.
Khatra uthayein (Take Risks): nayi cheezein aazmane se na darein, chahe pehli baar kamyab na hon. Bohat si kamyab innovations nakamiyon se seekh kar hi bani hain.
Aam soch se hat kar sochein (Think Outside the Box): masail ko mukhtalif zawiyon se dekhein. Kabhi kabhi behtareen hal woh hota hai jo kisi aur ne socha hi na ho.
Mil kar kaam karein (Collaborate): doosron ke saath kaam karne se naye ideas jagte hain aur innovative hal milte hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq pehli online Urdu dictionary (lughat) ek Pakistani innovator ne banayi, jis ne apni creativity se zaban seekhna zyada aasan bana diya! (Kitab us shakhs ka naam nahi batati.)

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Apne college ya mohalle ka koi aisa masla sochein jis ka hal chahiye. Groups mein mil kar is masle ke creative hal sochein (brainstorm karein). Apne ideas class ke saamne pesh karein!

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: groups mein college ya mohalle ke kisi masle ke creative hal soch kar pesh karein. Ek tajweez (suggestion) dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Maslan canteen ki lambi qataaron ke liye: pehle se order likhne ki sheet ya messaging group, ta ke break ke waqt khana tayyar mile. Yeh sirf samjhane ke liye misal hai.

items: Innovation aur creativity barhane ke tareeqe: curiosity, risk lena, aam soch se hat kar sochna, collaboration.
